objective: Auditar SQL-first la regresion de Operaciones > Analisis de Inventarios donde no se enlistan almacenes y, por dependencia, desaparecen recurrentemente inventarios iniciales/finales. Identificar exclusivamente la fuente canonica EDARSAHUB SQL existente para almacenes por unidad y la fuente canonica ya publicada para inventarios fisicos. No crear tablas/columnas, no LIVE POS, no Mongo, no hardcodes, no DML/DDL. La evidencia debe permitir parche determinista y pruebas anti-regresion que garanticen Unidad -> Almacenes -> Inventarios inicial/final.

queries.name: warehouse_candidate_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Almacen%' OR t.name LIKE '%Inventario%' ORDER BY t.name;

queries.name: warehouse_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Almacen%' OR t.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Comercial_Inventarios_Fisicos','Inventarios_Fisicos','Inventario_Fisico') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id;

queries.name: cienfuegos_unit_identity
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(id AS varchar(100)) AS unidad_id, codigo, nombre, CAST(server_id AS varchar(100)) AS server_id, sucursal_origen_id, system_type, activo FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio WHERE UPPER(codigo)='CIENFUEGOS' OR UPPER(nombre) LIKE '%CIENFUEGOS%';

queries.name: inventory_canonical_candidate_views
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, v.name AS view_name FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=v.schema_id WHERE v.name LIKE '%Invent%' OR v.name LIKE '%Almacen%' ORDER BY v.name;

queries.name: inventory_sync_tables_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Inventario%Fisic%' OR t.name LIKE '%Inventarios%Sync%' OR t.name LIKE '%Inventario%Sync%' ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id;

requester.chat: Inventarios Analisis - blindaje almacenes e inventarios
